Field.Label: Enable live room and hot-water setpoint writes

Live writes support the standard room target (3–37 C) and DHW target (10–60 C), whole degrees only, on the verified KO2B/209F endpoint. Polling must be enabled and target readings valid. A recent successful controller-clock health check is required. Each write checks the target, acknowledgement and readback; uncertain writes are not retried. Reduced/party writes remain simulator-only. Connection and polling settings are on the system device.
